long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Rome, New York, and Miami, Frank Paul Ripa earned a civil-engineering degree from the University of South Florida. His early career moved through municipal engineering, regional planning and private consulting. In 1981 he co-founded Florida Land Design and Engineering, then later directed environmental-construction work for Florida Remediation Services.

In 1998, Ripa bought that company's infrastructure division and renamed it RIPA & Associates. Beginning with about ten employees and municipal work, the Tampa firm expanded into earthwork, utilities, roads, paving and large residential and commercial sites across west-central Florida. Ripa eventually handed day-to-day leadership to his son-in-law, Chris LaFace, while remaining a company manager and licensed general contractor.
